name: ProBook Ultraslim Laptop
description: Experience lightning-fast performance with the ProBook Ultraslim Laptop featuring the latest Intel Core i7 processor and 16GB RAM. Its stunning 15.6-inch Full HD display and 10-hour battery life make it perfect for professionals on the go.

name: NovaSmart X12 Smartphone
description: The NovaSmart X12 combines a 6.7-inch AMOLED display with a 108MP triple-camera system for stunning photos and videos. Powered by a 5000mAh battery with 65W fast charging, you'll stay connected all day.

name: SoundWave Pro Headphones
description: Immerse yourself in rich, detailed audio with SoundWave Pro's 40mm custom drivers and active noise cancellation. The plush over-ear cushions and 30-hour battery life ensure comfortable listening sessions all day long.

name: ChronoElite Smart Watch
description: The ChronoElite Smart Watch tracks your health metrics including heart rate, SpO2, and sleep quality in real time. Its sapphire crystal display and 5ATM water resistance make it both beautiful and durable for everyday wear.

name: SnapPro DSLR Camera
description: Capture life's most precious moments with the SnapPro DSLR Camera featuring a 24.2MP APS-C sensor and 4K video recording. Its intuitive touchscreen interface and built-in Wi-Fi make sharing your creativity effortless.

name: UrbanEdge Classic T-Shirt
description: Crafted from 100% organic cotton, the UrbanEdge Classic T-Shirt offers everyday comfort with a modern fit. Available in 12 colors, it's pre-shrunk and machine washable for effortless care.

name: ArcticShield Winter Jacket
description: Stay warm and stylish with the ArcticShield Winter Jacket, featuring 650-fill power down insulation and a water-resistant shell. Its slim silhouette and packable design make it ideal for both city commutes and outdoor adventures.

name: FlexRun Elite Sneakers
description: Engineered for performance and style, the FlexRun Elite Sneakers feature a breathable mesh upper and responsive foam midsole for all-day comfort. Their versatile design transitions seamlessly from gym sessions to casual outings.

name: LuxLiving Modern Sofa
description: Transform your living space with the LuxLiving Modern Sofa, upholstered in premium stain-resistant fabric with high-density foam cushions. Its solid hardwood frame and clean contemporary lines ensure lasting elegance and comfort.

name: AmbientGlow Arc Floor Lamp
description: The AmbientGlow Arc Floor Lamp adds warm, adjustable lighting to any room with its energy-efficient LED bulb and three brightness settings. Its slender arc design and weighted marble base create a stylish focal point without cluttering your space.

name: MindScape: The Art of Thinking
description: MindScape is a groundbreaking exploration of cognitive science and creative thinking, drawing on the latest neuroscience research to help you unlock your full mental potential. Through compelling stories and practical exercises, it guides readers to sharper problem-solving and richer creativity.

name: TrailBlaze Pro Sports Bag
description: The TrailBlaze Pro Sports Bag offers 45L of organized storage with dedicated compartments for shoes, wet gear, and electronics. Made from water-resistant 600D polyester with reinforced handles, it's built to handle the toughest training sessions.

name: PowerFlex Resistance Band Set
description: The PowerFlex Resistance Band Set includes 5 bands with varying resistance levels from 10 to 50 lbs, perfect for strength training and physical therapy at home or the gym. Made from premium natural latex, they are durable, snap-resistant, and come with a convenient carry bag.

name: CodeCraft: Full-Stack Mastery
description: CodeCraft: Full-Stack Mastery walks developers through building production-ready web applications from frontend to backend, covering React, Node.js, databases, and cloud deployment. With real-world projects and expert insights, it bridges the gap between tutorial code and professional software engineering.
